data_description.labs: {labs_adds}Try out new integrations, actions and action options, and unproven devices. Labs features may misbehave, change or be withdrawn without notice. Please report how they go with the "Report a device test result or bug" form.
data_description.predicted_state: When dimming starts, Hue Bridges report 0% or 100% brightness and only snap back to a light's actual brightness after ~10 s. This setting shows the starting brightness in Home Assistant when dimming starts, and the light's actual brightness when it stops. Disable the setting to get the raw bridge reports.
data_description.z2m_color_modes: Full color lights use both XY and HS modes, but Zigbee2MQTT announces them as XY mode only which breaks HA reports. This setting overrides Z2M and announces both modes to HA. Turn it off to revert to Z2M's native behavior.

migrate_hue_dimmer.title: Hue Smooth Dimming can be replaced by DeviceSide
migrate_hue_dimmer.description:
DeviceSide's actions are drop-in replacements for Hue Smooth Dimming's. In your automations and scripts, change:

- `hue_dimmer.raise` to `deviceside.raise_brightness`
- `hue_dimmer.lower` to `deviceside.lower_brightness`
- every other `hue_dimmer.` to `deviceside.`

The fields and responses are the same. Both can run side by side while you switch, and Ignore hides this notice for good. Once no automation or script calls `hue_dimmer.`, remove the Hue Smooth Dimming integration.

raise_hue.name: Raise hue

hs_color.description: Color in hue/sat format. A list of two numbers: hue 0-360, saturation 0-100.
